subject: Make the Firebase client emulator-aware so tests have a real isolation boundary
description: Required by Chris during the 378 gate 2026-09-09, and the ONLY real fix for the incident logged alongside it. TODAY THERE IS NO ISOLATED MODE. _app is a no-build static site: serving it from python3 -m http.server changes which server hands out the FILES, not which backend the JavaScript calls. FIREBASE_CONFIG hardcodes projectId 'hexworth-prime' in both _app/components/FirebaseAuth.js and _app/arena/firebase-init.js, and a grep of the whole _app tree finds ZERO connectAuthEmulator / connectFunctionsEmulator / connectFirestoreEmulator / useEmulator calls. So a page served at 127.0.0.1 still signs in against production identitytoolkit and still invokes the production deliverFlag. Any harness guard that calls a localhost base 'local' is applying a false label. WHAT CURRENTLY MASKS IT, and why it must not be relied on: the API key carries an HTTP-referrer restriction, so 127.0.0.1 and preview-channel origins are refused with auth/requests-from-referer-<origin>-are-blocked. That is an accident of key configuration, not a boundary, and it evaporates the moment anyone allowlists localhost to make another test work - which was nearly proposed during task 377 to get its no-session arm running. WORK: gate connectAuthEmulator/connectFunctionsEmulator/connectFirestoreEmulator behind an explicit signal (env-injected flag, query param, or a separate config file) in FirebaseAuth.js and firebase-init.js; NEVER start the functions emulator, it loads functions/.env and has fired live Discord webhooks. Task 372 already built an auth+firestore emulator harness at _tools/hexos/anon-load-signin-emulator.test.js - reuse its setup. Closing this also unblocks task 379 (377's no-session completability, currently only verifiable in production).
activeForm: Working on: Make the Firebase client emulator-aware so tests have a real isolation boundary
